description: A smartphone lies on a green bedspread with a white charging cable plugged into it, and both hands in sweater sleeves are positioned nearby. The right hand moves in toward the phone, taps and grips it, then lifts it slightly as the left hand reaches to the cable tip and pulls it free; the phone becomes a right-hand object while the cable is briefly a left-hand object, and both are then set back down on the bed.
